import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import mir_eval

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
mir_eval.display.pitch(times, ref_freqs, midi=True, ax=ax)
mir_eval.display.ticker_pitch(ax=ax)

formatter = ax.yaxis.get_major_formatter()
# MIDI note 69 corresponds to A4 (or A3/A5 depending on octave numbering convention)
label_69 = formatter(69, 0)

assert 'A' in label_69, f"Expected 'A' in label for MIDI 69, got {label_69}"
print(f"__CHECK__ ticker_pitch {label_69}")
